text:
Rina: quick read  we need to pick two Optimize items this sprint: (A) Console live hints for batching & cache, (B) eval-triggered regression alerts, (C) quantization recommendation engine. opinions?
Joe: A + B. Hints = easy customer wins. Alerts = builds trust for upgrades.
Priya: +1. For alerts we must define debounce + "confirm before notify" to avoid noise.
Marco: quant recs need model benchmarks + canary rollout automation  recommend research spike only.
deploy-bot: staging: console-batching-hints v1 -> deployed :rocket:
Rina: MVP proposal:
- Hints MVP: per-route batching suggestion (limit to top-3), one-click cache TTL presets, cost delta estimate.
- Alerts MVP: eval-driven alerts for concordance drop OR embedding drift, feature-flagged, require 2 consecutive failing runs, 24h quiet window, default to "confirm before notify".
Priya: sample signal rule:
```
alert: concordance_fall
threshold: 0.07
min_runs: 2
quiet_window: 24h
notify_mode: confirmed_only
```
Joe: timeline: Hints ~1 week, Alerts ~1.5 weeks if we reuse eval infra. Marco: agreed, will scope quant spike for next sprint.
Rina: decision: ship Hints + slim Alerts behind FF for pilot. Marco to draft SLI for FP rate <10%. Priya to write signal doc. Joe to create tickets. Reconvene Thu for go/no-go. :thumbsup:
